title: Nicolás Maduro back in court as trial date set for June 2027
text:
Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, were back in court Wednesday as a trial date was set for their criminal drug trafficking charges. CBS News’ Katrina Kaufman has more.
